oya-cloud-marketplace-domain/kernel already had seller/listing/private offer/entitlement/fee and kernel command-shaping tests but no live provider marketplace integration.

cell-lifecycle, cell-rebalancer, finops-portal, marketplace, and ops-dashboard-control-center manifests overclaimed missing crates/layers, measured SLOs, audit-chain runtime, DR, sharding, mesh, IaC, OSS runtime, and provider integrations.

official_sources_used.name: Google SRE Handling Overload
official_sources_used.relevance: Resource-based capacity, per-customer quotas, criticality, throttling, retry budgets, and overload handling require measured runtime evidence; this slice keeps only metadata guardrails and no overload runtime claims.

official_sources_used.name: Kubernetes Node Autoscaling
official_sources_used.relevance: Node autoscaling is cluster runtime behavior; this slice does not claim Kubernetes autoscaler/controller implementation.

official_sources_used.name: FOCUS Specification
official_sources_used.relevance: FOCUS 1.3 is the current uniform billing/cost dataset specification as of this work; this slice does not claim FOCUS data generation/export.

official_sources_used.name: OpenCost Specification
official_sources_used.relevance: OpenCost defines vendor-neutral Kubernetes infrastructure/container cost measurement and allocation; this slice does not claim OpenCost ingestion or Prometheus/Mimir federation.

official_sources_used.name: Uptime Institute Tier Classification System
official_sources_used.relevance: Data-center tier claims require facility infrastructure/topology evidence; this slice validates DCOps domain metadata only and does not claim certification or facility runtime.

official_sources_used.name: AWS Marketplace SaaS products
official_sources_used.relevance: SaaS sellers manage customer access/provisioning and subscription/contract integration; this slice validates marketplace domain metadata only and does not claim provider marketplace API integration.

official_sources_used.name: AWS Marketplace SaaS product guidelines
official_sources_used.relevance: Marketplace products with customer data need security-relevant audit logging; this slice records audit-chain runtime as an explicit non-claim while guarding evidence ref lanes.
